purpose: Pilot-scoped, NON-OPERATIONAL concept-level SCIENTIFIC claims for Pilot 03 (molybdenum_disulfide). Kept OUT of the canonical claim registries. All three are concept-level scientific claims established from authoritative databases / primary crystallographic literature, independently of the German lexical chain. Supporting evidence IDs are mandatory. Claim approval does not authorize publication.
lexical_separation_note: The lexical chain (molybdenum_disulfide -> LEX-DE-MOS2-001 -> EVD-MOS2-DE-001 -> SRC-SPEKTRUM-MOS2-DE) is UNTOUCHED and is NOT used to support any of these scientific claims. SRC-SPEKTRUM-MOS2-DE remains German-terminology-only.

claims.statement: Molybdenum disulfide has the molecular formula MoS2.
claims.sufficiency: primary_plus_corroborating satisfied (two independent government scientific databases)
claims.scope_guard: Chemical composition identity only. Not structure, not a physical property.

claims.statement: In its 2H polytype (molybdenite), molybdenum disulfide crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P 6_3/m m c (No. 194) as a layered structure (a = b ~ 3.15-3.16 Angstrom, c ~ 12.3 Angstrom, gamma = 120 deg).
claims.sufficiency: primary_plus_corroborating satisfied (two independent primary crystallographic determinations, 1923 + 1983)
claims.polytype_scope: 2H ONLY. The 3R polytype (space group R3m, c ~ 18.3 Angstrom) is DISTINCT and must not be conflated; monolayer/few-layer forms are out of scope.
claims.scope_guard: Structural identity of 2H-MoS2. Not a numeric-property claim beyond the identity; not an electronic property.

claims.pilot_claim: C — one physical/material property (lattice parameter a)
claims.statement: The in-plane hexagonal lattice parameter a of 2H-MoS2 (bulk) is reported as 3.15(2) Angstrom (Dickinson & Pauling 1923) and 3.161 Angstrom (Schonfeld, Huang & Moss 1983).
claims.sufficiency: primary_plus_corroborating satisfied; values preserved separately (no averaging, no forced single value)
claims.form_scope: 2H bulk ONLY. A monolayer/few-layer or 3R value must never substitute for this.
claims.numeric_normalization: NUM-EN-DOT-DECIMAL; source_literal and normalized_value stored distinctly; uncertainty (0.02 A on the 1923 value) preserved; no unit conversion.
claims.conflict_handling: The two determinations agree within uncertainty (~3.15-3.161 A); both are kept as coexisting evidence records rather than reconciled to one scalar.

not_attempted_property_band_gap.note: Band gap was considered for Claim C but NOT attempted as an admitted claim: it is strongly form-dependent (bulk 2H is an indirect-gap semiconductor; monolayer MoS2 is a direct-gap semiconductor), and an authoritative PRIMARY source with the exact values/conditions was not openly retrievable in this environment (peer-reviewed publisher pages gated; no AI summaries or search snippets used as evidence). Recorded as a future scientific-evidence + form-scope target (see report). No band-gap value is asserted.
